title: Surjectivity on an affine cover implies a quasi-coherent-target epimorphism
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M,N$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $N$ quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and $\varphi:M\to N$ a morphism. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be affine opens covering $X$. If $\Gamma(U_i,\varphi)$ is surjective for every $i$, then $\varphi$ is an epimorphism in the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules (equivalently, locally surjective).

source.place: epi_of_surjective_app, lines 365-386; its basic-open argument uses Stacks Schemes 01IA and 01HV

proof.text: Given y on W and x in W, choose an affine-cover member U_i containing x and a basic open D(g) containing x and contained in W intersect U_i. By the affine basic-open localization theorem, the restriction of y to D(g) becomes the restriction of a section t on U_i after multiplication by a power g^k. Lift t to z on U_i using the assumed surjectivity. Since g is invertible on D(g), g^(-k) times the restriction of z lifts y there. Thus the map is locally surjective; the forgetful functor to sheaves of abelian groups reflects epimorphisms, and a locally surjective sheaf map is epi. This is the complete proof of the existing source declaration epi_of_surjective_app.
